source_matrix.scope: Five configured representative points; not all roads or whole corridors. Observation time and ingestion availability are retained; current operations reject stale points.

contributes_to: exact directed-edge route planning costs only when permission/config/quality/freshness/binding gates pass
source_matrix.scope: Camera counts/occupancy are not measured speed, deduplicated fleet volume or delay. No stale camera rows enter live results; no camera rows are relabelled as speed-training targets. Current edge contribution is independently reported.

contributes_to: road context features for observed forecasts
source_matrix.scope: Mapped nodes/edges and nearest geometry are not live traffic observations, surveyed capacity, or verified lane/direction matching.

contributes_to: causally available weather features for forecasts
source_matrix.scope: Weather features select the captured response available at the forecast origin; regional grid weather is not a road sensor.
Timetable slots are scheduled operations, not live vessel/AIS status or measured road congestion. Observed-only road forecasts do not add an assumed ferry-surge adjustment.
Exact canonical corridor/direction mapping is unverified; not imported into live speed history or promoted to citywide serving forecast.
Volume/capacity ratios remain saturation measurements; raw vehicle counts/speeds are absent and no synthetic km/h labels are manufactured.

contributes_to: separate historical benchmark in observed forecast analytics
source_matrix.scope: One final test day and no canonical five-corridor mapping; no production promotion or invented free-flow labels.

source_matrix.source: Singapore academic speed bands and Guangzhou speed benchmark
source_matrix.scope: Foreign-road evidence is labelled by geography and units. It does not validate Batam camera counts, current road speeds or citywide accuracy.

contributes_to: explicit include_modelled historical preview and permitted demo scenarios only
source_matrix.scope: Excluded from observed history and real-traffic model training. Modelled hotspot areas remain labelled non-observed even when they consume real corridor signals.

fixes.problem: Public model-status exposed forest-candidate MAE/R2 even when the release gate serves persistence.
fixes.change: Published metrics now use the actual gated30min serving strategy; forest-candidate holdout metrics/importances remain separately scoped.

fixes.problem: Prospective evaluation summary opened the writer/schema initializer, requiring write access for a read-only analytics view.
fixes.change: Summary now opens SQLite mode=ro/query_only with one consistent read transaction; missing/uninitialized ledgers are not created or silently populated.

fixes.problem: Complete real provider snapshots unnecessarily depended on forecasting/modelled telemetry twice, so a cold model could break the live congestion endpoint.
fixes.change: Complete measured provider snapshots and explicitly supplied hotspot signals bypass forecast fallback; hotspots retain non-observed scope and their metadata identifies resolved inputs.

runtime_change_status: Source changes are tested locally but are not loaded by the running API until the parent coordinates its restart; no restart performed by this audit.
limits: This receipt is a timestamped source audit, not a claim that all44 catalogued cameras are public/live/authorized for processing.
Five sampled provider points and modelled hotspot areas do not establish whole-network measured coverage.
Release/validation, source geography, units, chronology and freshness gates remain enforced.
No new model, registry setting, camera mapping, credential, authentication rule, or email was created by this audit.
